tools.name: smartwebchat_service_info
tools.description: Get factual information about the Smartwebchat service itself: what it does, plans and prices, interface languages, where data is processed, and how to obtain an API key. Works without authentication — use it to answer questions about Smartwebchat before the user has an account.

tools.name: smartwebchat_list_chatbots
tools.description: List the website chatbots in this account, with their IDs, names and the site each one runs on. Call this first — every other tool needs a botId from here.

tools.name: smartwebchat_create_chatbot
tools.description: Create a new website chatbot for a business, including its greeting, personality and initial FAQ knowledge. Writes to the account: confirm the business details with the user before calling. Needs a key with full access; a read-only key gets 401 here.

tools.name: smartwebchat_chat
tools.description: Send a visitor message to a chatbot and get its reply, exactly as a website visitor would see it. Use this to test how the chatbot answers, or to check whether its knowledge base covers a topic. tools.name: smartwebchat_get_leads
tools.description: Retrieve the leads a website chatbot captured from visitors — contact requests, appointment bookings and callback requests, with the visitor's message and contact details. Without botId, returns the leads of every chatbot in the account.

tools.name: smartwebchat_update_lead
tools.description: Change the status of a captured lead, for example to mark it as contacted or closed. Writes to the account. Needs a key with full access; a read-only key gets 401 here.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "smartwebchat_create_chatbot" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Create a new website chatbot for a business, including its greeting, personality and initial FAQ knowledge. Writes to the account: confirm the business details …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: smartwebchat_chat, smartwebchat_get_leads · Private data: smartwebchat_service_info, smartwebchat_chat, smartwebchat_get_leads · Public sink: smartwebchat_chat.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: smartwebchat_chat, smartwebchat_get_leads · Private data: smartwebchat_service_info, smartwebchat_chat, smartwebchat_get_leads · Public sink: smartwebchat_chat

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
